notes: 3D context (right, top): Mazowiecka 19 modelled from the official inventory drawing (pilasters with capitals, balusters, pediments on consoles, crowning cornice), weathered plaster, per-stone paving tones, granite curbs, 3D grass near camera, bridge pylon with the restored helmet in the distance.

Façade generator v2 (right, bottom): outline split into straight and curved 'runs'; bays distributed by arc length, so the piers follow the R-14 m bridgehead corner exactly — the signature element of the winning concept.

Synthesis brief to the lead designer: keep K5's single gesture; fix every juror objection (Sejmik level area & lobby corridor, presidium not against the light, no 'technical storey' above the hall, vertical rhythm with ceramic lamellas instead of horizontal bands, 3 m wall distance at plot 10/2, honest PV count); graft only ideas that strengthen the gesture.

Output will be machine-readable (model/koncepcja.json: volumes with coordinates & levels, cores, grid, façade parameters, camera list) so drawings, tables F.15/F.14.B and renders are generated from one source of truth.
Three independent verifiers (geometry/MPZP/§13; programme & Sejmik floor; cost/ecology/façades) will try to break the spec before revision.
